messages:
Priya: Heads-up 1: proposing rollout plan for fallback_v2 (routing + model-fallback). Primary goals: incremental exposure, observable quality deltas, and strict tenant isolation for opt-in customers. Looking for product/eng/SRE sign-off.

Oliver: Sounds good. I suggest a four-step path: internal alpha (dev + infra), customer opt-ins (24 tenants), regional A/B canary (5% traffic A/B), wide regional ramp (25% then 100%). Each step gated.

Jun: Perf checklist for alpha: run steady-state with KV-cache warmed, burst profile, and tail-latency runs. Example command: `tools/loadbench --model=rw-7b --qps=150 --seq_len=384 --warm_kv --profile=tail` 1 capture p50/p90/p95/p99, CPU/GPU utilization, and allocation churn.

Maya: SRE asks: define automated circuit-breaker and manual overrides. My draft: automated rollback if error_rate >= 1.5% for 3m OR p95 latency >= 2.5x baseline for 4m OR CPU/GPU satur > 90% for 2m. Also require a manual kill-switch button in Console.

Tom C: Customer constraints: two enterprise tenants need guaranteed pinning (they must not be routed to fallback variants) and a post-GA quiet period of 72h. We must support tenant-level flag override at routing plane.

Priya: Gate metrics (per-phase):
- p95 latency <= 350ms for hosted small models
- error rate <= 0.8%
- eval metric delta (production-facing metric) <= 1.5% regression
- cost/unit change <= +8%
Gates: pass 3 consecutive 1h windows for alpha, 6h for tenant opt-ins, 24h for regional canary.

Oliver: Flagging scheme proposal so rollout service can target traffic slices: `feature.rollouts/fallback_v2:<region>:slice:<percent>` default = off. We'll implement API in rollout-service to flip.

Jun: Will add an auto-rollback hook in CI job. Pseudo snippet: `if [ "$ERR_COUNT" -gt 50 ] || [ "$P95" -gt 800 ]; then curl -sS -X POST $OPS_HOOK -d "{\"action\":\"auto_rollback\",\"variant\":\"fallback_v2\"}"` 1 then ops-bot posts.

ops-bot: Canary launched: fallback_v2 -> us-east-1, trial slice: 5% A/B. CI id: build-3987, job: canary-1713001111.

Leah: On observability: add per-tenant request counters, per-variant latency histograms, and a canary vs baseline diff widget. Also add an alert for any tenant with error spike > 0.5% absolute increase.

Maya: Also add distributed trace sampling for canary traffic (tag traces with `rollout=fallback_v2`) so devs can compare qualitative regressions.

Priya: Decision on A/B vs shadow: run A/B (5% of traffic split 50/50) for quality signal plus shadowing for heavy tails. We want automated eval harness to score outputs and produce a daily report.

Oliver: Can we run offline evaluation on sampled responses? If we store samples to s3 and run the eval harness (`eval_harness/run --samples s3://canary-samples/1713001111`) we can compute metrics quickly.

Jun: Agree. I'll wire in sampling and an eval job that runs every 30m during canary and posts summary to #product. We'll also emit sample diffs to the analytics bucket.

Tom C: I'll draft the customer sign-off checklist: tenant pinning confirmation, acceptance criteria, and quiet-window agreement. Will send to the two tenants tomorrow.

Priya: Action items: 1) Jun implement rollout API + sampling + auto-rollback, 2) Maya build dashboards/alerts/traces, 3) Tom finalize tenant sign-off doc, 4) Oliver update rollout-service flag format and API, 5) Leah coordinate eval harness outputs into shiproom.

Oliver: Freeze windows: no production rollouts Fri 17:00 1 Mon 11:00 PT. Also prefer morning canary starts (before 11:00 PT) to maximize overlap with ops.

Maya: Runbook items: ownership list, SLO thresholds, rollback command, pager flow, and steps for tenant unpinning. I'll draft and link.

Priya: Timeline: alpha next Wed 09:00 PT, tenant opt-ins the following week, regional A/B canary 2 weeks after alpha if gates pass. Shiproom invite to follow.

ops-bot: Noted: shiproom scheduled for 1713086400, channel #release-war-room.

Priya: Thanks everyone. If no blockers by EOD today we'll schedule alpha and open the shiproom invite.
